statement: Killed the third frog in party dungeon using Bowman with help of Twitch chat; Bowman is the worst class for party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: He placed Bowman at the bottom of his party dungeon tier list as the worst class for party dungeons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Initial plan was go in as Bowman with bows and use great grumbleo and a couple of sugar rushes; expected it to be easy.

creator: griffybit
statement: Reason it was so hard was clear speed from bottom to top was too slow; no progress after about 10 attempts.

creator: griffybit
statement: Beginner spear gives AOE; using a spear on Bowman gave faster clearing (same trick as Maestro in Coliseum).

statement: Grumble build got close to killing third frog but was not enough so it was scrapped.

statement: Switched to the RNG voucher build which gave more consistent and better results.

statement: To kill third frog with Bowman they needed to get the Horn of the Full (RNG item) for enough damage; the only way to succeed.

statement: Good start: leave the two frog camps on the left side then clear the middle and all huts except the red lizard hut.

statement: Got the horn once but did not have enough crit and took it too soon.

statement: About 90 percent of his legendary drops were Stone of the Bulwark.

statement: Finally killed third frog with Bowman on the last run of a Monday stream in week three.

statement: The challenge took three weeks and over 14 hours of party dungeons.
